prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Work Sans; warm expressive serif with open functional sans. Use Spectrum 1-5: page #19161D, text #F6F3F7, accent #E58AB4, secondary surface #373725, text on accent #111111. Use body 20px, heading 80px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
